reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Warriors.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back. Golden State, who have lost four straight and were beaten by 22 in Dallas, will rest Draymond Green (right elbow), and Stephen Curry (oblique) is not re-evaluated until Nov 25. Memphis are buoyant after a franchise-record eighth straight road win in Cleveland, even with Ty Jerome sidelined, and beat the Warriors in October after a late collapse. The angle leans towards Memphis.
